final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS a FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS b FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.rfistat, step1.a, step1.a - step2.b AS a_minus_b FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step1.a > step2.b AND step2.b IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS d FROM step3) SELECT step3.rfistat, step3.a AS c, step3.a_minus_b, step3.a - step4.d AS c_minus_d FROM step3 CROSS JOIN step4 WHERE step4.d IS NOT NULL
